shortDescription: Library mod: gives any pawn randomly rolled, hidden-until-discovered titan traits and materials, with naming, inheritance, visuals, light, ability AI and player settings. Content mods define the traits.
body:
## Purpose
Library mod for a later dungeon mod. Gives any pawn (animal, humanlike, mech) a set of rolled traits and a material. Content mods define the traits; this mod handles storage, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, visuals, light, materials, ability AI, hiding of undiscovered traits, diets, market value and info card rows.

## Status
- Everything through diets + market value + diet display tested (summary commit ff195c8, builds 46–54).
- Info card trait list (builds 55–56): not yet tested.
- Phase 3 remaining: optional VRE gene compat.

## Info card rows (Source/TitanCard.cs)
Postfix on RaceProperties.SpecialDisplayStats adds to Basics (just under "Race"): "Material" (hyperlink to the stuff) and "Titan traits" (comma list, ??? for unknown). The traits tooltip: intro, then per discovered trait its description, stage effects (from the trait's own stage, not the merged one), diet lines, TipStringExtra and its market value; unknown traits show ??? and their stock description only; a note about the trade mystery bonus if any are unknown. Per-trait values are unfloored (the stat applies the 10% floor to the total).

## Startup
Settings load in the Mod constructor. Harmony PatchAll runs in `[StaticConstructorOnStartup] TitanPatcher`. TitanMaterialStartup appends StatPart_TitanTraits then StatPart_TitanMaterial to MarketValue.

## Market value (Source/TitanValue.cs)
- Base value = MarketValue before the framework's parts. Traits part runs before the material part.
- Per trait: `marketValuePercent` / `marketValueOffset` on the def if set; else pointCost × (base × `valuePercentPerPoint` 0.2 + `valueFlatPerPoint` 100). Total never below 10% of base.
- Trade (TradeSession active AND Dialog_Trade open) = discovered traits + mystery bonus (base × `mysteryTradeBonus` 0.25, once). Info card = discovered only. Everything else (wealth, raid points) = all traits.
- API: TitanValueUtility.TraitPoints, BaseValue, TraitsValue.

## Diet (Source/TitanDiet.cs, TitanTraitDef.diet)
- XML `diet`: addFoodTypes, removeFoodTypes, refuseFoods, extraFoods (thing + nutrition for non-food), hunts.
- Merged per creature with own material (setting `materialNutritionPerUnit` 0.05). Patches: FoodIsSuitable, IsPotentiallyPredator, BestFoodSourceOnMap, JobGiver_GetFood.TryGiveJob → TF_EatNonFood job.
- Display: hediff tooltip lists each discovered trait's diet lines; info card Diet row rewritten from race diet + material + discovered traits.
- Known gaps: JobGiver_EatRandom and right-click ingest use the race diet.

## Inheritance (Source/Patches.cs)
BirthContext from DoBirthSpawn, CompHatcher.Hatch, ApplyBirthOutcome; applied in TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn / ApplyBirthOutcome postfix. Chance 1-(1-chance×setting)^carriers; discovered if a parent knew it.

## Ability AI (Source/TitanAI.cs)
DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob postfix → JobGiver_TitanAbilities every 30 ticks. Not for player colonists. Setting `abilityAI`.

## Discovery
Notify_PawnUsedVerb; Ability.Notify_StartedCasting wraps preCastActions so the reveal happens when the lead-in starts.

## Hiding (Source/TitanHiding.cs)
During DrawStatsReport: discovered-only stage, hidden-only hediffs nulled, caches cleared. Ability.GizmosVisible hides hidden-trait abilities.

## Settings tabs
Lights and effects / Traits (inherit, messages, ability AI, value %, value silver, mystery bonus) / Materials (armor, damage, fire, butcher, precious, market value, nutrition).

## Harmony patches (27)
BestKindLabel; ApplyBirthOutcome ×3; DoBirthSpawn ×2; CompHatcher.Hatch ×2; TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn; DropBloodFilth/Smear; MakeCorpse; Corpse.IngestibleNow; ButcherProducts; DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob; Notify_StartedCasting ×2; DrawStatsReport ×2; Hediff.CurStage; GizmosVisible; FoodIsSuitable; IsPotentiallyPredator; BestFoodSourceOnMap; JobGiver_GetFood.TryGiveJob; RaceProperties.SpecialDisplayStats ×2 (diet, traits).

## Debug actions
Add trait…, Roll traits…, Set material…, Discover all traits, Clear titan.

## Example content (remove Defs/Examples AND Patches/TF_ExampleMaterials.xml together before publishing)
Flaming, Venomous, Ironhide, Of the Deep, Rockgut, Bloodthirsty, Brittle, Irradiated, Firebreather.
